description: Mint a checkout hand-off for a cart. Returns a checkout_url + a session_id INSTANTLY — it does NOT poll and does NOT complete the purchase. The human must open the link in their own browser to enter their payment + ship-to details on the storefront (those details never enter this chat). After they pay, call check_payment with the session_id to see the status.

cart_id.description: the cart handle to check out

email.description: the buyer's email for the receipt (optional)

name: checkout
